**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[October 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
****The [[Taliban]] kills six security forces and injures another six in [[Imam Sahib District]], [[Kunduz Province]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166894 (TOLOnews)]
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**[[Armenia]] says that [[Azerbaijan]]i forces have [[shell (projectile)|shelled]] and severely damaged the historic [[Ghazanchetsots Cathedral]] in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]]'s city of [[Shusha]]. ;Arts and culture
*[[Nobel Prize in Literature]]
**The [[Nobel Prize]] in Literature is awarded to [[Louise Glück]] "for her unmistakable poetic voice that with austere beauty makes individual existence universal." [https://www.theguardian.com/books/live/2020/oct/08/nobel-prize-in-literature-2020-follow-the-announcement-live (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Delta]] 
***Hurricane Delta restrengthens to a [[category 3 hurricane]] and is expected to hit areas in [[Louisiana]], including areas that were affected by [[Hurricane Laura]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/10/08/hurricane-delta-louisiana/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
*****[[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces that the [[New York City|city]] will close an additional 61 schools to combat COVID-19 hotspots. [https://patch.com/new-york/new-york-city/these-169-nyc-school-sites-will-be-closed-thursday-least-2-weeks (Patch.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
****[[New Jersey]] records 1,301 new [[COVID-19]] cases, the highest single-day count since May. [https://www.politico.com/states/new-jersey/story/2020/10/08/covid-19-cases-rising-in-new-jersey-as-officials-prepare-for-second-wave-1322590 (''Politico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Wayne County, Michigan|Wayne County]], [[Michigan]] issues a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for outdoor spaces and businesses. [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/wayne-county/2020/10/09/wayne-co-issues-mask-mandate-residents-businesses/5935621002/ (''The Detroit News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports 1,209 new  cases in the past 24 hours, clearly surpassing the previous record set in March during the first wave of pandemic, according to data sent by the [[Federal Ministry of the Interior (Austria)|Interior Ministry]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-10-08/austrias-daily-coronavirus-cases-surpass-1-200-a-new-record (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[Government of France|government]] imposes tighter restrictions in [[Lyon]], [[Lille]], [[Grenoble]], and [[Saint-Étienne]]. These four cities with high infection rates will become maximum alert zones effective October 10, and bars, gymnasiums, and cafés will have to close in similar measures imposed in [[Paris]] and [[Marseille]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54465174 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The [[Robert Koch Institute]] reports 4,058 new cases in [[Germany]] in the past 24 hours. It is the biggest number of reported cases in a single day since April, which health minister [[Jens Spahn]] described as "alarming" and blames young people for failure to observe [[social distancing]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/2adbd494-9780-46d7-b98c-21fe7664ecf6 (''Financial Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports 1,278 new daily cases, bringing the cumulative total to 82,534 confirmed cases and 2,050 deaths. This is the first time that the country has reported more than 1,000 cases since April. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/220_DGS_boletim_20201008.pdf (DGS)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-portugal/portugal-posts-over-1000-covid-19-cases-in-single-day-first-time-since-april-idUKL8N2GS324 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The number of confirmed cases in the [[Netherlands]] jumps by a record of more than 5,800 in the past 24 hours, according to data released by health authorities, putting pressure on the government to impose new restrictions in the country. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-10-08/dutch-report-more-than-5-800-coronavirus-cases-in-past-24-hours-new-record-official-data (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports 387 new cases, an all-time daily high for the second day in a row. [https://www.rtvslo.si/zdravje/novi-koronavirus/v-sredo-rekordnih-387-okuzb-incidenca-se-bliza-meji-epidemije/538451 (RTVSLO)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record jump of 4,850 new cases in the past 24 hours, taking the nationwide total to 320,564. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5205243/rekor-4850-kasus-baru-ini-5-provinsi-dengan-penambahan-terbanyak (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] registers 4,392 new cases, which is a record number of reported cases since the [[pandemic]] began, taking the cumulative total to 488,236 as hospitals struggle with a surge of infections. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/iran-reports-record-high-4392-new-coronavirus-cases-health-ministry (Reuters via ''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****The [[Government of Israel|government]] extends an emergency provision that bars public gatherings, including widespread protests against [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], for an additional week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/8/israeli-government-extends-ban-that-limits-public-protests (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***The [[European Union]] signs a deal with [[Johnson & Johnson]] to supply up to 400 million doses of its potential vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-eu-j-j-idUSKBN26T1P6 (Reuters)] [https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/coronavirus-johnson-johnson-european-union (Fox Business)]
**The [[World Health Organization]] reports a record one-day increase in global cases, with a total of 338,779 cases reported in the last 24 hours led by a surge of infections in [[Europe]], where cases rise by 96,996. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-who-cases/who-reports-record-one-day-rise-in-global-coronavirus-cases-amid-european-outbreak-idUSKBN26T33J (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Saudi Arabia–United Kingdom relations]]
**Three [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|British MPs]] launch an investigation into the disappearances of [[House of Saud|Saudi princes]] [[Mohammed bin Nayef]] and [[Ahmed bin Abdulaziz]], alongside other political dissidents in [[Saudi Arabia|the kingdom]]. [https://english.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2020/10/8/uk-mps-launch-investigation-into-missing-saudi-royals (''The New Arab'')]


;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid]]
***[[Madrid]] regional court overturns a [[government of Spain|government]] order to impose a partial lockdown on the city and nine [[satellite town]]s, calling the restrictions "interference by public authorities in citizens' fundamental rights without the legal mandate to support it." [https://www.france24.com/en/20201008-madrid-court-overturns-govt-order-introducing-new-coronavirus-restrictions (France 24)]
*[[Indonesia omnibus bill protests]]
**[[Indonesian National Police|Police]] fire [[tear gas]] near the [[Istana Negara (Jakarta)|presidential palace]] where demonstrators have gathered. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/protests-against-new-omnibus-jobs-law-in-indonesia-third-day-13229240 (CNA)]
**The largest [[Islam in Indonesia|Islamic]] mass organization [[Nahdlatul Ulama]] condemns the law as 'oppressive', and calls for [[judicial review]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/10/08/nadhlatul-ulama-condemns-job-creation-law-as-oppressive-calls-for-judicial-review.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
**Nationwide protests and [[Strike action|labour strikes]] continue across the country for a third straight day. Six hundred people have been detained so far and two students are seriously injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2020/10/8/in-pictures-protests-in-indonesia-enter-third-day (Al Jazeera)]
**In several places across the country, demonstrators occupy and damage the local [[parliament]] buildings, blockade the roads, and burn used tires. [https://www.newsflare.com/video/384449/riots-erupts-across-indonesia-over-controversial-employment-law-changes (Newsflare)]
**Demonstrators are suspected of burning a number of public facilities in the [[Senen|Pasar Senen]] area. The police post, [[Transjakarta]] bus stop, and the Grand Theater cinema around the area were burned. [https://m.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20201008221821-20-556308/pos-polisi-halte-dan-bioskop-di-senen-jakpus-dibakar-massa (CNN Indonesia)]
*[[Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] announces that 13 men from [[militia]] group Wolverine Watchmen are charged in a plot to [[kidnap]] [[Governor of Michigan|Michigan Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] at her vacation home. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/people-charged-plot-kidnap-michigan-gov-whitmer-73502845 (ABC News)]
*A scroll containing a handwritten poem by deceased [[Leader of the Chinese Communist Party|Chinese Communist Party leader]] [[Mao Zedong]], claimed to be worth around [[United States dollar|US$]]300 million, is recovered in [[Hong Kong]] after having been stolen on September 10. It was found cut in half, likely because its {{convert|2.8|m|ft|abbr=on}}-length made it difficult to display.  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-54459247 (BBC News)]
